source_snapshot.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON file-hash map (UTF-8)

protocol.summary: Median of all retained formal runs; decode token/s = replay length / median total decode time.
protocol.timing_boundary: Loading and external prompt construction excluded; forward, argmax, host token completion and final decode forward included.
protocol.repeat_policy: One reverse PyTorch/Lumen pair when either initial prefill range divided by median exceeds 25%. All runs retained.
protocol.i8_policy: I8 weights with BF16 activations/runtime/KV; dynamic activation I8 off; no PyTorch I8 ratio.
